content:
> I just wanna hold this boy's hand, okay? Like, even if it wasn't *him*, I just wanna hold a boy's hand in the hallway, lined up against the walls of public rejection, getting ostracized for being who I am. WHY does anyone care? Why do they HATE us for loving? It's so ironic, it makes my brain hurt.  
>  
> It feels so weird to hear people casually insulting us like we don't even exist. Any chance of a social life I had before would be completely OBLITERATED by coming out of this cage. Like, I just wanna be a cute girly boy, what’s WRONG with that? Seriously, what’s the issue here?  
>  
> I just wanna hold this boy's hand! 😭
